sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 2 9B | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 2 9B is a compact vision language model built on Qwen3.5 9B that stores weights as ternary values of negative one, zero, and positive one. Its 2GB footprint is more than 9 times smaller than the full precision model. It supports reasoning, visual understanding, instruction following, and tool calling, and runs locally on NVIDIA GPUs and Apple devices.

sources.title: Ternary Bonsai 2 9B - Bonsai
sources.snippet: Ternary Bonsai 2 9B is the mid-size model in the family, for laptops and desktops. It is derived from Qwen3.5-9B, a hybrid-attention vision-language model, with the architecture unchanged. Every language-model weight is ternary: {−1, 0, +1} in a fixed rotated basis, with an FP16 scale per group of 128 weights.
